mcfloatingbackpack.configuration.title: Floating Backpack Settings
How far the floating panel goes in working with other mods. Lower or turn off the compatibility with one mod here when they conflict.
mcfloatingbackpack.configuration.logging: The mod's own diagnostics. When something goes wrong (for example a backpack disappears) a higher level puts more leads into latest.log.
config.mcfloatingbackpack.logLevel.toolt: How much diagnostics go to latest.log. OFF: none. ERROR: only what went wrong and lost something. WARN: also suspicious things (for example a backpack that vanished from a player's inventory, with that player's last panel actions). INFO: also notable things that are not wrong (for example a backpack that was dropped). DEBUG: also every panel click and creative-cursor message; a lot of lines, use it to chase a bug. Each player's last panel actions are kept in memory whatever this is.
config.mcfloatingbackpack.modLevels.tool:
One entry per mod, written modid=LEVEL, e.g. sophisticatedbackpacks=OFF. A mod that is not listed is at FULL.
FULL: mod-specific adaptation. Turns on the code we wrote for that mod: active compatibility with it, which can also be seen as an enhancement (today only jei has one: it makes JEI keep clear of the panel).
GENERIC: no mod-specific adaptation. Turns off any code we wrote for that mod; for a mod we wrote nothing for, GENERIC is the same as FULL. It does not decide whether the panel shows on the mod's screens or whether Ctrl+click can move items between the panel and its menus: that depends on how the mod implements its containers, and the closer to vanilla containers, the better it works.
OFF: the panel is not shown. The panel and that mod's UI are either/or (for jei, which only decorates other screens, the same as GENERIC).
For a mod that registered search terms for the backpack search (the public API), GENERIC and OFF mean its search terms are ignored.
Vanilla (minecraft) cannot be configured. The first time the panel is shown on a mod's screen the log tells which mod id to use. Mistakes in this config are reported in the chat.
